desc: Desync healing, a defeated enemy: playing together in the Rogueport Sewers (tik_01), the host's game defeats its Spiky Goomba at frame 1,300 and never says so (TTYD_SYNC_CORRUPT npc_dead:enemy, as a lost SS_R_NPC_DEAD). The host's room digest has the enemy gone and its defeat recorded; at two in a row the guest's game logs DRIFT room, records the defeat and defeats its own copy, so it can't be met there any more

room: .* defeated here too \((gone in the owner's room|recorded in the owner's room)\)
